# Yard Guard Landscaping

> Artificial turf installation consultations for homes in Mississauga, Etobicoke, and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), including lawn, pet-area, and backyard putting-green projects.

Key facts:
- Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Serves Mississauga, Etobicoke, Toronto, Brampton, Vaughan, Oakville, Markham, Richmond Hill.
- Phone: (647) 216-7787
- Email: contact@yardguardlandscaping.com
- Pricing: property-specific and provided in an itemized proposal after site details are reviewed.
- Public pricing policy: no universal price-per-square-foot range, savings amount, financing example, or guaranteed payback is published; proposals identify the actual scope, assumptions, options, and applicable documents.
- Cost comparisons: any future comparison should disclose area, scope, local lawn-care and water inputs, ownership period, turf-care and replacement assumptions, taxes, and homeowner time.
- Warranty policy: manufacturer product coverage and YardGuard workmanship terms are separate; the written documents for the selected system control.
- Differentiators: local GTA consultation, itemized project quotes, specialized pet and putting-green options, and an established landscaping team.

## Services & Products
- [Pricing & Products](https://ygtoronto.com/products.html): Compare lawn, pet-area, putting-green, and integrated-landscape options, then request an itemized site quote.
- [Pet Areas](https://ygtoronto.com/pets.html): Planning considerations for drainage, cleaning, heat, durability, care, and product documentation in dog-use areas.
- [How It Works](https://ygtoronto.com/how-it-works.html): The installation process from consultation to finished lawn.
- [Design Consultation](https://ygtoronto.com/get-3d-design.html): Learn how YardGuard reviews project goals, site conditions, measurements, and the recommended design approach.
- [GTA Artificial Turf Rules](https://ygtoronto.com/bylaws.html): Municipal sources and property-specific planning checks for Toronto, Vaughan, Brampton, and Mississauga. Artificial turf is not automatically treated as soft or permeable landscaping.
- [Artificial Turf Mississauga](https://ygtoronto.com/artificial-turf-mississauga.html): Local service page for Mississauga.

## Learning Centre
- [Artificial Turf Learning Centre](https://ygtoronto.com/learn.html): A growing library of practical, source-aware guides for GTA homeowners.
- [Complete Residential Artificial Turf Guide](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-residential-artificial-turf.html): Comprehensive reference covering system components, site review, installation, drainage, heat, children, pets, care, environmental tradeoffs, cost, GTA planning, warranties, and buying questions.
- [Artificial Turf 101](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-artificial-turf-basics.html): Understand turf, infill, base, drainage, edging, installation, and care as one system.
- [Base and Drainage Guide](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-base-drainage.html): Questions to ask about excavation, aggregate, grading, soil, outlets, and site boundaries.
- [Artificial Turf Cost Guide](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-turf-costs.html): Compare complete project scope and disclosed cost assumptions without a universal payback promise.
- [Mississauga Rules, Grading and Drainage](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-gta-rules-drainage.html): Address-specific planning checks for stormwater, downspouts, soft landscaping, utilities, trees, easements, and written approvals.
- [Pets, Children and Families](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-pets-children-artificial-turf.html): Heat, hygiene, pet waste, infill, play, supervision, cleaning, and use-zone planning.
- [Maintenance, Cleaning and Repairs](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-maintenance-cleaning.html): Four-season care, debris, stains, infill, weeds, furniture, pet areas, snow, inspections, and repairs.
- [Heat and Summer Safety](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-artificial-turf-heat.html): Shade, water, surface checks, hot-weather timing, children, pets, and heat-source precautions.
- [Installation Process](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-installation-process.html): Site review, scope, excavation, base, drainage, seams, edges, handoff, and records.
- [Backyard Design](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-backyard-design-artificial-turf.html): Use zones, planting, trees, shade, circulation, accessibility, furniture, and mixed surfaces.
- [Winter, Snow and Freeze-Thaw](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-winter-snow-artificial-turf.html): GTA winter planning, snow removal, ice, salt, spring inspection, and meltwater.
- [Alternatives and Mixed Surfaces](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-artificial-turf-alternatives.html): Compare natural lawn, planting, mulch, pavers, decking, turf, and hybrid plans.
- [Contractors, Proposals and Warranties](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-hiring-contractor-warranty.html): Compare scope, evidence, product documents, workmanship terms, change orders, and project records.
- [How Artificial Grass Is Made](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-how-artificial-grass-is-made.html): Resin, masterbatch, yarn extrusion, blade geometry, tufting, backing, curing, inspection, traceability, and manufacturing change control.
- [Artificial Turf Specifications](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-artificial-turf-specifications.html): Pile height, gauge, stitch rate, face weight, dtex, polymers, backing, tuft retention, permeability, UV evidence, tolerances, and exact-SKU comparison.
- [Infill Options](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-infill-options.html): Infill materials, particle grading, ballast, pile support, heat, migration, pet claims, maintenance, and evidence scope.
- [Testing, Standards and Certifications](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-testing-standards.html): Test methods, specifications, ASTM standards, FIFA programmes, lab accreditation, product reports, playground claims, PFAS methods, and evidence auditing.
- [Health and Safety Evidence](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-health-environment-evidence.html): Current evidence and limitations for heat, crumb rubber, PFAS, lead, PAHs, metals, VOCs, children, pets, and residential versus sports-field exposure.
- [Environmental Impact and Lifecycle](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-environment-lifecycle.html): Water, runoff, microplastics, heat, soil, trees, biodiversity, production, maintenance, replacement, recycling, and disposal.
- [Installation Quality Control](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-installation-quality-control.html): Construction hold points and diagnosis for ponding, settlement, wrinkles, seams, edges, odour, heat damage, and fibre loss.
- [Product and Quote Comparison Worksheet](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-product-comparison-checklist.html): Printable site, product, evidence, installation, maintenance, warranty, and end-of-life checklist.
- [Artificial Turf Glossary](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-glossary.html): Searchable definitions for more than 70 manufacturing, specification, installation, testing, health, and environmental terms.
- [Editorial Standards](https://ygtoronto.com/learn-editorial-standards.html): Source hierarchy, claim taxonomy, sports-versus-residential scope, review dates, limitations, and corrections practice.
